turnaround_reason: FOXF makes performance suspension and components for powersports, off-road trucks, and bikes. It was crushed by post-COVID channel destocking, weak discretionary demand, and a leveraged balance sheet (Marucci + specialty-bike acquisitions layered on debt). A cost-out program and channel normalization are driving a gradual earnings recovery off deeply depressed levels (~35% of its 200-week MA).
bullish_points: Q1 2026 beat: EPS $0.18 vs $0.08-0.09 est, revenue $368.7M (+3.9% YoY) above consensus; management reaffirmed the FY26 outlook ($1.328-1.416B sales, $174-203M adj EBITDA).
Phase 2 profit-optimization targets ~$40M of savings in 2026 (on top of $25M in 2025); management guides to margin expansion in H2 2026 as those cost benefits land.
Phoenix divestiture proceeds are being applied to debt paydown and reduced inventory, cleaning up a stretched balance sheet.
Trading near trough valuation: ~1.2x book, forward P/E ~10.8, EV/EBITDA ~10.3, price $18.80 vs 52-wk range $13.08-$31.18. Analyst mean target ~$21.7.
Recovering screen mode confirmed: above 200d MA, and multiple sequential earnings beats (Q1 and prior quarter) suggest the operational trough is behind it.
bearish_points: Heavily leveraged: total debt $787M vs $54M cash, debt/equity ~120x, EV $1.5B nearly 2x market cap. Covenants were tightened alongside Q1 — limited margin for error if demand rolls over.
Trailing profit margin -20% (includes a $10M divestiture loss and heavy interest/amortization); operating margin only 1.6%. Recovery is real but thin and not yet proven durable.
End markets (powersports, off-road trucks, high-end bikes) are discretionary and rate-sensitive; a consumer slowdown or another destocking wave would hit hard.
Options are effectively untradeable for size (total call OI 165, put OI 77, only 3 expiries) — spot only.
Short interest elevated at ~11.5% of float / 5.34 days-to-cover; a beat could squeeze but it also reflects real bearish conviction.
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings after the close on Aug 6 — the test of whether H2 margin-expansion guidance is on track. Guidance: sales $343-365M, adj EBITDA $32-40M, EPS ~$0.31 est.
suggested_trade: Spot position only, small-to-starter size. Options are too illiquid. Consider building ahead of Aug 6 only in starter size given binary earnings risk; add on a confirming beat + reaffirmed/raised H2 margin guide.
key_risk: A soft Q2 print or a cut to the H2 margin-expansion guidance would break the recovery thesis on a name that can't afford disappointment given its leverage — the stock could retest the low teens.
would_skip_if: You want liquid options exposure, or you're unwilling to hold a highly-levered cyclical into a binary earnings event. Also skip if the Q2 print shows margins not inflecting despite the cost program.
